fixed_route.name: FULL_FUNCTION_STRUCTURED_DNNF_BOTTOM_UP_STATE
fixed_route.semantics: The live decomposition/compilation state preserves the exact Boolean function of the accumulated constraints in a structured decomposable NNF representation.
fixed_route.bottom_up_model: Clauses/constraints are combined by exact conjunction/apply, with restructuring/vtree changes allowed where the cited theorem allows them.

scope_correction.reason: Without fixing a representation/operational model this is too strong: the original CNF itself is an exact representation of its Boolean function, and SAT-only summaries may preserve less information than full-function compilation.
scope_correction.admitted_claim: For the fixed structured full-function compilation route, unconditional exponential representation and intermediate-live-state lower bounds are known.

source.title: Connecting Width and Structure in Knowledge Compilation

theorem_A_final_representation_lower_bou.statement_used: For monotone CNF of constant clause arity a and variable degree d, every SDNNF representation has size exponential in treewidth; quantitatively the published bound is singly exponential in tw with the exponent weakened by a,d factors. Hence for fixed a,d the lower bound is 2^{Omega(tw)}.
theorem_A_final_representation_lower_bou.TRUMP_effect: A route that insists on exact full-function SDNNF/d-SDNNF state cannot promise polynomial live size on arbitrary polynomial-size CNFs with unbounded treewidth.

source.title: Lower Bounds on Intermediate Results in Bottom-Up Knowledge Compilation

theorem_B_intermediate_live_state_lower_.statement_used: There is a class of CNF formulas with constant-size final str-DNNF representations such that any bottom-up compilation in the studied general str-DNNF model, using conjunction and restructuring, must produce intermediate str-DNNFs of exponential size; consequently the process requires exponential time and space.
theorem_B_intermediate_live_state_lower_.TRUMP_effect: Even a small final exact structured representation does not imply a polynomial L4 live-state envelope for bottom-up compilation: intermediate debt can be exponentially larger than the final object.

derived_L4_barrier.claim: FULL_FUNCTION_STRUCTURED_DNNF_BOTTOM_UP_STATE cannot serve as a universal polynomial-state L4 discharge for TRUMP.
reason: Some bounded-arity/bounded-degree CNF functions require structured exact representations exponential in treewidth.
Independently, bottom-up structured compilation can require exponentially large intermediate live states even when the final representation is constant-size.
Therefore neither final succinctness nor exact structured decomposition alone supplies the universal polynomial live-state bound required by L4.

dead_zone_information_firewall.requirement_for_successor: Any compressed boundary/state summary must prove a context-complete equivalence theorem for the exact decision semantics it claims to preserve.

what_is_not_proved: No lower bound is claimed for every possible exact SAT algorithm or every possible state representation.
No lower bound is transferred automatically from structured DNNF to arbitrary circuits, arbitrary proof systems, or SAT-only summaries.
Unbounded treewidth alone is not being asserted to imply superpolynomial space for all algorithms.
This barrier does not prove P!=NP.

next_admissible_math.question: Can TRUMP define a weaker-than-full-function, SAT-sufficient state semantics and prove a polynomial-size context-complete quotient for arbitrary 3CNF, or can a lower bound be proved for that precisely fixed quotient model?
forbidden: dropping boundary information without an exact equivalence theorem
transferring the str-DNNF barrier to all representations
